prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. High-fidelity mobile app UI design comp. Flat frontal screenshot of one phone screen at 390x844 viewport proportion.

Surface: The Ranger's Road, "Log a walk": a private, offline training app screen for recording a walk the person has just finished. The visitor's job: enter one fact per screen with one thumb and move on. It must read instantly as a working app form, one step of a short sequence.

Reference image: it carries the visual world to keep exactly: header bar, warm paper page, serif plus sans pairing, small spaced-caps field labels, bordered tap-scale buttons, pine button, bottom tab bar. Do NOT copy the reference's content or layout (no readiness text, no energy scale); this screen shows one question, described below.

Layout, top to bottom:
1. Header bar as in the reference.
2. A text link with a left arrow: "Back to Road".
3. Small sans line "Log a walk · Step 2 of 6", and under it a thin progress rule split into six equal segments, the first two filled pine, the rest pale rule gray.
4. A quiet answered-summary row on parchment tint: "Distance" label, serif "2.1 miles", and a small "Change" text link on the right.
5. The question, very large serif, two lines: "How long did you walk?"
6. One large bordered numeric field, full width, about 96px tall, holding the serif numeral "41" at display size with the unit "minutes" in sans to its right inside the field.
7. Small help line: "Round to the nearest minute."
8. Generous empty paper below, then two buttons side by side near the bottom: a secondary bordered "Back" button on the left third and a wide pine "Next" button with a right arrow on the right two thirds, sitting just above the tab bar.
9. Tab bar.

Text, verbatim and correctly spelled: "The Ranger's Road"; "Back to Road"; "Log a walk · Step 2 of 6"; "DISTANCE"; "2.1 miles"; "Change"; "How long did you walk?"; "41"; "minutes"; "Round to the nearest minute."; "Back"; "Next"; "Keep"; "Road"; "Forge"; "Journal"; "Field Manual".
Palette only: Night Forest #172B21 for the header bar, Pine #24362B for primary buttons and selected scale options, warm paper #F6F3EA page, Parchment Tint #E9E5D8 for quiet notices, rules #D4D1C7, Gold Line #A9804A only as the selected tab's short underline, Ink #171A17, Secondary Ink #4F514D. Flat surfaces with 1px borders and 6px corners, no shadows.
Type: a sturdy bracketed book serif for the page title, questions, section headings and all numerals; a narrow humanist sans for labels, help lines, inputs and buttons. Field labels are small spaced capitals in sage gray, like the reference. No decorative fonts.
Top of the screen: the same dark forest header bar as the reference, with the small gold three-pine mark and "The Ranger's Road" in cream serif. Bottom: the same five-tab bar as the reference, "Keep", "Road", "Forge", "Journal", "Field Manual", with "Road" selected (pine, short gold underline).
Avoid: maps, route lines, running figures, invented goals or targets, pace, XP, points, streaks, badges, charts, photos, forest scenery, fake parchment texture, glow, 3D, device frame, status bar, hands.
